summary: OpenAI published a patch release (v1.0.4) of its codex-plugin-cc developer tool fixing several bugs including cwd handling, agent frontmatter, argument quoting, and command routing.

practices.reason: Minor bug fixes to a developer plugin could affect teams already using codex-plugin-cc but require no urgent migration work.
